description: Retail buy and sell rates a commercial bank displays on its own website (e.g. SBI's TT buying rate, an Emirates NBD or HSBC Hong Kong board), read hourly. Use for 'what rate does bank X give for USD today?', remittance comparisons between banks in one country, or rules that name a bank's card rate (India Income-tax Rule 115 uses SBI's TT buying rate). These are bank prices, NOT official or mid-market rates: for those use get_official_rates or get_exchange_rate. Give `country` alone for every covered bank there, or add `bank` for one board; `ccy` narrows one bank to a currency and `date` returns the stored board for a past day. Covers 1,200+ commercial banks in 120+ countries (ae, lk, in, pk, bd, np, vn, id, ph, am, az, ge, kz, tw, jp, kr, hk, cn, au, cz, pl, hu, tr, eg, za, ke, us); codes are listed at https://allratestoday.com/bank-exchange-rate-api/. Requires ALLRATES_API_KEY (the free key works).

bank.description: Bank code within the country, e.g. 'sbi', 'fab', 'hsbchk'. Omit for every covered bank.

ccy.description: Narrow one bank's board to a single currency, e.g. 'USD'. Needs `bank`.

date.description: Stored board for a past day, YYYY-MM-DD (kept about 400 days). Needs `bank`.

name: get_bank_rates

basis.description: Which board this is, e.g. Telegraphic transfer

buy.description: One currency: what the bank pays per unit

quote_ccy.description: Home currency every rate is quoted in

sell.description: One currency: what the bank charges per unit

title: Commercial bank buy/sell board rates
